seo.title: MiniMax H3 Max: 1080P Video, References & Audio
seo.description: Generate 5–15-second MiniMax H3 Max videos from text, frames or image, video and audio references, up to 1080P with native audio.

overview: Create 5–15-second videos from text, opening or ending frames, or mixed references. H3 Max offers 480P, 768P and 1080P output, prompt expansion, native audio and an optional soundtrack for text or image generation.

hero.title: MiniMax H3 Max
hero.subtitle: Turn more ideas into moving scenes.
subtitleHighlights: Turn more ideas into moving scenes
hero.paragraph: MiniMax H3 Max creates 5–15-second videos from text, frames or image, video and audio references in 480P, 768P or 1080P. Use it on the website or through MCP. Generate native audio or supply a soundtrack for text and image workflows; choose MiniMax H3 when you need 2K or 4K.

features.title: Choose your output resolution
features.body: Render at 480P, 768P or 1080P and choose balanced or quality prompt expansion to develop your scene.

features.title: Direct with frames or references
features.body: Use a start image, an end image or both. In reference mode, guide identity, movement and sound with images, videos and audio clips.

features.title: 5–15-second clips
features.body: Choose any whole-second duration and a landscape, square or vertical format for text-to-video.

features.title: Native audio or your soundtrack
features.body: Generate dialogue, ambience, music and effects, or supply a soundtrack in text and image modes. Audio-only references are also supported in reference mode.

decisionCards.title: Choose H3 Max up to 1080P
decisionCards.body: Choose H3 Max for text, frames and mixed references up to 1080P. Compare MiniMax H3 when your delivery needs 2K or 4K.

decisionCards.title: See MiniMax H3 for 2K and 4K
decisionCards.body: MiniMax H3 adds 2K and 4K output while keeping text, frame and multimodal reference workflows. Compare both models with the same brief and current quote.

referenceWorkflows.title: Text-to-video
referenceWorkflows.body: Describe the subject, action, camera and sound. Add an optional soundtrack to guide the audio.

referenceWorkflows.title: Image-to-video
referenceWorkflows.body: Use a start image, an end image or both, with an optional soundtrack. Keep frame inputs separate from mixed references.

referenceWorkflows.title: Reference-to-video
referenceWorkflows.body: Use up to 9 images, 3 videos and 3 audio clips within 12 unique references. Audio-only references work too; video and audio each have a 15-second combined limit.

referenceWorkflows.title: Native audio or a supplied soundtrack
referenceWorkflows.body: Use a soundtrack in text or image mode, or audio references in reference mode. Describe dialogue, ambience and synchronized sound cues in the prompt.
